header: Getting to the Elbkai Congress Centre
subheadline: The venue is on the north bank at Grosse Elbstrasse 148, about 20 minutes west of the main station. Your delegate badge covers all city transport for the three days.

routes.description: From Hamburg Hbf, take the S1 or S3 to Altona, then bus 111 two stops to Fischmarkt. The entrance faces the water, opposite the ferry pier.
Leave the A7 at Bahrenfeld and follow the signs for Altona. The garage under the building has 180 spaces at EUR 4 an hour, bookable with your pass.
The S1 runs from Hamburg Airport to Altona every 10 minutes and takes 34 minutes. A taxi costs about EUR 45 outside the morning rush hour.
